items.title: Maximising data capture in obesity trials
items.summary: ICON’s pragmatic DXA strategy captures complete visceral fat datasets, preventing “silent attrition” and protecting trial integrity, timelines, and budgets.

items.title: GSK’s Nucala secures NICE COPD endorsement
items.summary: NICE now recommends Nucala for both severe asthma and COPD, expanding the drug’s clinical uptake across the UK’s public health service.

items.title: Radiopharma on the rise: Are supply chains ready?
items.summary: Learn how specialized logistics and end-to-end orchestration help ensure treatments arrive on time, on temperature, and fully compliant.

items.title: Pfizer and Innovent Biologics sign $10.5bn cancer drug development deal
items.summary: Pfizer and Innovent Biologics have signed a global licensing and collaboration agreement worth up to $10.5bn for the research and development of a portfolio of 12 early-stage cancer medicines.

items.title: FDA grants priority review for Sanofi’s venglustat NDA
items.summary: Sanofi has received a priority review from the FDA for its NDA for venglustat, an oral GCSi intended for the treatment of type 3 GD3.
